page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.large is an entry-level instance within the Enhanced server family, operating on a KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, delivering 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with Hyper-Threading enabled. The system features 4.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU) and a 48 MB L3 cache, complemented by 48 KB L1d and 1 MB L2 caches. The instance carries no bundled local storage and requires network-attached volumes. Network connectivity provides a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. Hardware capabilities include AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA instruction extensions.

Benchmark results demonstrate a clear structural divide between single-core and multi-core output on this instance. The stress-ng single-core test yields a score of 1890.38 (placing in the middle 50%), while multi-core stress-ng scores drop to 1934.88 (bottom 10%), highlighting the contention of executing multi-threaded workloads on a single physical core. Passmark CPU scores reach 2992.59, with Passmark memory scores at 931.93. Uncached memory bandwidth tests recorded 10.57 GB/sec for large block reads and 12.34 GB/sec for writes. Workload tests show a Redis SET throughput of 1.98 million operations per second, static web serving output at 3.63 GB/sec, and 135M model LLM text generation at 59.28 tokens per second.

The hardware configuration creates specific trade-offs regarding resource density and execution throughput. While dedicated CPU allocation provides consistent single-threaded execution, memory capacity and memory bandwidth remain restricted. The absence of local storage adds dependency on remote disk attachments for persistent data. This profile offers cost efficiency primarily for minimal footprint services where advanced instruction extensions like AVX-512 or cryptography hardware acceleration are required without demanding substantial memory or multi-core parallelism. Workload fit includes basic microservices, lightweight web servers, small background job processors, and general-purpose edge applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.large is an entry-level virtual server powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. Configured with 2 vCPUs on 1 physical core with Hyper-Threading, it features 4.0 GB of RAM, a 48 MB L3 cache, and a 2 Gbps baseline network connection. The instance provides no bundled local storage or dedicated GPUs. Benchmark results demonstrate average single-core CPU performance alongside lower multi-threaded throughput and memory bandwidth, reflecting resource constraints associated with a single physical core configuration. Hardware instruction support includes AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AES cryptographic acceleration. Due to its limited memory capacity and modest overall compute output, ecs.c7t.large offers a basic dedicated resource profile tailored for lightweight microservices, low-traffic web serving, basic background processing, and utility workloads.
